LanguageData.VGE_AdvancedGravshipWeaponry.label: advanced gravship weaponry
LanguageData.VGE_AdvancedGravshipWeaponry.description: Construct advanced gravship weaponry, warpods and targeting consoles, as well as gravship bombardment targeters.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipDefenses.label: gravship defenses
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipDefenses.description: Reinforce the gravship by constructing gravship armor and subarmor, new compact turrets and gravmines, as well as gravship shield generators, making it much more resistant to enemy fire.
LanguageData.VGE_AdvancedOrbitalTech.label: advanced orbital tech
LanguageData.VGE_AdvancedOrbitalTech.description: Construct various buildings and apparel that improve the comfort and security of living in harsh vacuum of space.
